data.description:
## Description

**What**: New plugins/dso/scripts/regenerate-strata-sdk-facts.sh pinned to specific upstream tag/commit recorded in plugins/dso/scripts/lib/strata-template-vars.sh. Reads SDK source via gh api at pinned ref. Parses generators, attribute types, class hierarchy, gem dependencies, route definitions, class doc-comments into structured intermediate (JSON). Renders three views: concepts.md (~30 lines), decomposition.md (~60 lines), implementation.md (~120 lines), plus README.md index. Each output gets AUTOGENERATED header, schema-version pin, sdk-ref pin, completeness flag (full | partial-conditional-chain-<N> | partial-runtime-types-<N>). Documents 5 spike-identified caveats inline. Atomic write via mktemp+mv; manual-residual-index.json schema {topic_id, content, last_modified}; regeneration reads index, regenerates auto sections, splices manual content via deterministic key-lookup. Idempotent re-run zero diffs.
**Why**: Tiered facts must auto-regenerate from upstream to prevent staleness; manual residuals must survive regeneration without LLM-preserved markers.
**Scope**:
- IN: Regeneration tool; three facts files (concepts/decomposition/implementation/README); manual-residual-index.json schema + splice logic; AUTOGENERATED header + schema/sdk-ref/completeness pins; 5 caveats inline; gh api at pinned ref.
- OUT: Per-skill manual guidance files (separate story); per-skill conditional loading (separate stories); CI fresh-check + drift detection (separate story).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, three facts files match golden-master at all tiers ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, atomic write via mktemp + mv ← Satisfies: SC1, behavioral guarantee atomicity
- When complete, idempotent re-run produces zero diffs in any facts file ← Satisfies: SC5
- When complete, manual-residual-index.json round-trip preserves entries and splices content correctly ← Satisfies: SC5
- When complete, 5 caveats annotated inline in regenerated outputs ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, two non-blocking upstream tickets filed against navapbc/strata-sdk-rails (desc declarations + applicant-UI concept) — done-definition only, NOT epic SC ← Satisfies: epic In Scope
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for parsing branches, splice logic, atomic write

## Considerations
- [Reliability] gh api errors distinguishable from parse errors
- [Maintainability] Pinned sdk-ref documented in strata-template-vars.sh; never branch
- [Testing] manual-residual-index.json hand-edits permitted (NOT gated by CI fresh-check)

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a planning consumer, regeneration tool produces three tiered facts files from upstream strata-sdk-rails atomically
